mentions.name: TalkHabit
mentions.description: A voice agent that calls users on their phone for daily 4-5 minute conversations to practice language immersion, built with the Twilio API and an OpenAI model.
mentions.problem: Issues with interrupting the agent and the high costs of calling non-US numbers.
mentions.source_excerpt: A voice agent calls you on your phone, and you talk with them for about 4-5 min per day to practice language immersion. Using the Twilio API and the OpenAI model.

evidence.value: A voice agent calls you on your phone, and you talk with them for about 4-5 min per day to practice language immersion. Using the Twilio API and the OpenAI model.
